{"brief":"The user likes romantic comedies and has a strong interest in history, especially World War II films. They enjoy learning why conflicts started, would watch documentaries, and describe themselves as a huge PBS fan. Recent viewing includes Sherlock Holmes movies and Dunkirk, the latter on TV; they did not give specific opinions on these films.

They have seen only parts of Wonder Woman on TV. They enjoyed the action and comedy, found Wonder Woman attractive, and appreciated her spunk, assertiveness, and ability to take care of herself.

The first Matrix interested them, particularly the mystery and trying to figure out what was happening. They thought the second and third films were much less good. They also noted that it sometimes seemed “weird for weird’s sake,” although it held their interest.

They are not a big fan of movie musicals. They strongly dislike horror and specifically dislike Aliens, though they are unsure whether to classify it as horror or sci-fi horror. Being scared and jumping out of their seat are not entertainment to them; they refuse to go to horror movies and do not want to pay to be frightened.

They know little about The Shape of Water beyond its unusual title, its reputation as highly rated, and their uncertain recollection that it won one or two Academy Awards. They did not get into it at the time or see many trailers. More exposure might have led them to watch it, but they were explicitly unsure; this should not be treated as a firm dislike."}
